g.text: For a pedestrian struck by a car or light truck in the US, the risk of death reaches 10% at 24.1 mph

text.style: font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'Inter'; fill: #4a4741

g.text: (39 km/h), 50% at 40.6 mph (65 km/h) and 90% at 54.6 mph (88 km/h).

g.text: The curve is about as steep in four studies' data

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a4741

g.text: Each extra 5 mph multiplies the odds of death by about 2 to 2.8. No evidence the studies differ (p = 0.29).
